title: metadata-admin previews: render an app area's `description`, each RLS policy's `label` / `description`, and a `view` container's `label`
body:
Parent: objectstack-ai/objectstack#20299

A sub-issue of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20299 (family `display-annotations`, triage verdict ENFORCE, grade `5859600931`), split per triage's shape: 「`domain:spec` parent, with an objectui `domain:ui` sub-issue」. Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_014EJ1ED8X4MMrT18BhVx4tx`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) when it claimed the parent's ledger half. ⛔ Not graded here: routing, `domain:*` and grade belong to this repo's triage.

## Why

Four authored display keys are parsed and published by `@objectstack/spec`, but no Studio surface shows them to a human. The objectstack liveness ledger records each as `dead`. Under the maintainer's ruling that a designer preview rendering a display key to a human is its consumer (objectstack `packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, "Designer previews count as consumers"), rendering them is the whole of the fix. Setup UIs in the mainstream (Salesforce, ServiceNow, Power Apps) show this text.

## What this repo does today (read at objectui `dd3f7e1be`, objectstack's `.objectui-sha`)

All paths are under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/`.

| key | ledger row (objectstack) | today |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `app.areas[].description` | `liveness/app.json` `areas.description` | `AppPreview.tsx` reads no `areas` at all. |
| `permission.rowLevelSecurity[].label` | `liveness/permission.json` `rowLevelSecurity.label` | `PermissionPreview.tsx:129` reads the array, and `:182` renders only a count pill (`engine.permissionPreview.pill.rls`). |
| `permission.rowLevelSecurity[].description` | `liveness/permission.json` `rowLevelSecurity.description` | Same as `label`: count only. |
| `view` container `label` | `liveness/view.json` `label` | `ViewPreview.tsx:167` reads it into a single injected list view. But `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` renders no tab strip for one entry (`:1562`, `:2660`), so the label never reaches the screen. |

## The change

- **`AppPreview`** renders each area's `description` beside its label.
- **`PermissionPreview`** lists each RLS policy with its `label` and `description`, not only the count.
- **`ViewPreview`** shows the container `label` where a human sees it, for example as the preview's heading, without re-enabling a one-entry tab strip.
- A missing value is the control in each case: nothing renders and nothing falls back to invented text.
- Preview chrome goes through the designer locale, like the other preview strings.

⛔ Out of scope:
- `flow.description`, `hook.label` and `hook.description`. `ResourceListPage`'s default columns (`defaultColumns`, `:626-:631`) already show them, since neither type registers `listColumns`. The parent's ledger half cites that reader. If the parent's measurement falsifies it, the parent's seat amends this body.
- A `HookPreview`, for the same reason.

## Acceptance

- Each of the four keys is visible in its preview when authored, and absent when not. A pin per preview asserts both cases.
- Once this lands and objectstack's `.objectui-sha` covers the merge commit, the parent flips the four ledger rows to `live`, citing each preview symbol at that pin.

Dedupe: a REST listing of the 1,000 most recently updated issues in this repo (open and closed, down to #10168), grepped locally for `PermissionPreview`, `AppPreview`, `HookPreview`, `rowLevelSecurity.label` / `.description`, `areas.description` and `objectstack#20299`, gave 4 hits. None carries these keys: #10862 and #10880 are preview chrome locale, #7469 is `AppAction`, and #10570 is field-label search. The parent's seat-4 measurement `5880539559` found no carrier either.

Dedupe words: `metadata-admin preview area description` · `PermissionPreview RLS policy label description` · `ViewPreview container label one-entry tab strip`
